name: astra-antigravity-remote
description: Delegate tasks to Antigravity on your computer. Set up accounts, manage computers and review results in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Delegate coding, analysis, research from supplied sources, and document tasks to Antigravity on a computer you connect. Install the headless Windows companion once, then use ChatGPT to check or install provider tools, connect your own Codex and Antigravity accounts, and approve a workspace. Manage computers, pause or stop tasks, review results and request downloads in chat. Provider sign-in can require its normal browser or device approval. Keep the computer running while tasks run. Model access and provider quotas apply. Tasks can run commands and change files. Antigravity tool approval is automatic; terminal sandboxing is requested by default. An isolated Git worktree separates changes, not all filesystem access. Computer approval and plugin sign-in can remain until revoked. Verified companion updates install when idle. Startup is your choice; uninstall is available from ChatGPT and Windows Installed apps. Background notifications and file transfers depend on host support. Files use ChatGPT file APIs; unsupported hosts keep them on your computer without opening a browser download page. Provider credentials and full task logs stay on your computer; setup inputs, compact results and approved downloads pass through the hosted relay. The task does not inherit your conversation's web, browser or connector access. This is an independent service, not an OpenAI, Google or Anthropic product.
defaultPrompt: Delegate this authorized task to my paired worker and independently verify its result.
